brief: Plans walks over a list: answers the positions to visit, forward, backward, in a zigzag, by a condition, by a step or between two positions.
detail: It is the walking helper of stzList, which builds one over itself for its WalkNForward, WalkNBackward, WalkW, WalkUntil, WalkWhile and WalkZigZag methods; build one with new stzListWalker when you only need the plan of a walk. It never changes the list, so a stzList passed in stays intact. Every Walk method answers positions counted from 1, in the order the walk visits them, never the items: read the items with the positions, or use the XT forms that take :WalkedItems. The condition methods (WalkW, WalkUntil, WalkWhen, WalkWhile) take a test written with @item for the current item. The positions of WalkBetween and WalkFromTo are not clipped to the list. A walk whose step is 0 (WalkNForward, WalkNBackward, WalkForthAndBack, WalkZigZag) never ends. AddWalker, Walkers and Walker raise error R24 today because the class never declares the attribute they read. WalkAccumulating is a plain map, not a running total.
